title: Vegetarian Hot and Sour Tofu Soup
summary: A Chinese-inspired hot and sour soup with silky tofu, mushrooms and ribbons of egg in a peppery, tangy broth. It is warming, quick to make, and ideal for a satisfying vegetarian lunch.

ingredients.name: firm tofu, cut into thin strips
cornstarch, mixed with 3 tbsp cold water

steps: Put the vegetable stock, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, rice vinegar, black pepper and chilli into a large saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 5 minutes so the flavours infuse.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and simmer for 6–8 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender and the broth is fragrant.
Gently add the tofu strips and simmer for 2 minutes, taking care not to break them up.
Stir the cornstarch mixture again, then pour it into the soup while stirring. Simmer for 1–2 minutes, until the broth looks slightly glossy and lightly thickened.
Reduce the heat to low. Slowly drizzle in the beaten eggs in a thin stream while gently stirring in one direction to form soft ribbons. Cook for 1 minute, until the egg is just set.
Stir in the sesame oil and most of the spring onions. Taste and adjust with a little more salt, vinegar or pepper if needed.
Ladle into bowls and finish with the remaining spring onions. Serve hot.
